mentions.name: Jankara-style karaoke app
mentions.description: A karaoke application built using SingOnKey as a base, intended to work like the karaoke systems in Japanese karaoke boxes (Jankara), so the builder can sing with his wife like they did in Japan.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm using it as a base to make a karaoke application so I can sing with my wife like we did in Japan. Hoping to make it similar to the systems they had set up at Jankara.
mentions.author: jyapayne
